decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west  walsl of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 9 Sandra Close
Condition : 5 - The tree protection method statement & design strategy submitted with this application shall be implemented prior to and during the course of development hereby approved.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and double storey side extension, incorporating erection of pitched roof to rear extension to dwellinghouse.
